High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.question: Arun Palli has been the _____ of the court since 16 April 2025
High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.fact: Arun Palli has been the Chief Justice of the court since 16 April 2025. The Maharaja appointed Lala Kanwar Sain as the first chief justice, and Lala Bodh Raj Sawhney and Khan Sahib Aga Syed Hussain as puisne judges.

High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.question: This bill reorganised the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two union territories—Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh—as of 31 _____ 2019
High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.fact: This bill reorganised the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two union territories—Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh—as of 31 October 2019.
